segments.contextAfter: To respect users’ privacy, apps calling CMAltimeter’s `startRelativeAltitudeUpdatesToQueue` and `stopRelativeAltitudeUpdates` are now required to include the [`NSMotionUsageDescription`](https://developer.apple.comhttps://developer.apple.com/documentation/bundleresources/information_property_list/nsmotionusagedescription) string in their plist in order to receive data. Apps built with SDKs prior to iOS 17.5 and watchOS 10.5 without the `NSMotionUsageDescription` string in their plists will not receive data. Apps built with iOS 17.5 and watchOS 10.5 or later will crash if they do not have the `NSMotionUsageDescription` string in their plist as described in [`CMAltimeter`](https://developer.apple.comhttps://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremotion/cmaltimeter).  (125573971)
